sloka: व्याघ्रो मृगमिवादाय मृगराडिव दन्तिनम् ।ननाद हैहयो राजा हर्षादम्बुदवन्मुहुः ।। ७.३२.६६ ॥
transliteration: vyāghro mṛgamivādāya mṛgarāḍiva dantinam ।nanāda haihayo rājā harṣādambudavanmuhuḥ ।। 7.32.66 ॥

translations.english: The Haihaya king (Kārtavīrya Arjuna) roared repeatedly with joy, like a tiger seizing a deer or a lion capturing an elephant, and like a thundering cloud.
